behavioral.label: Refresh button
behavioral.evidence: onClick={refresh}; refresh() calls invoke('invoke_mcp_tool', {tool:'vox_mesh_nodes',...}) and invoke_mcp_tool('vox_mesh_queue_stats') via Promise.all, then sets nodes+queue state.

behavioral.label: Target node select (onChange)
behavioral.evidence: onChange sets targetNode state; value is used in dispatch() args as node_id. Meaningful local state change feeding a real backend call.

behavioral.label: Task kind input (onChange)
behavioral.evidence: onChange sets taskKind state; value is passed to dispatch() as task_kind arg.

behavioral.label: Source textarea (onChange)
behavioral.evidence: onChange sets source state; required field for dispatch(); passed as args.source to vox_mesh_dispatch.

behavioral.label: Dispatch button
behavioral.evidence: onClick={dispatch}; dispatch() calls invoke('invoke_mcp_tool', {tool:'vox_mesh_dispatch', args:{source, node_id?, task_kind?}}), handles success/failure toasts, sets dispatchResult, calls refresh().

visual.issue: statusTone() returns hardcoded Tailwind color classes: 'border-emerald-400/30 bg-emerald-400/10 text-emerald-300' (online), 'border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-400/10 text-amber-300' (maintenance), 'border-rose-400/30 bg-rose-400/10 text-rose-300' (quarantined). These bypass the design-system token layer.
Control plane error banner uses hardcoded 'border-amber-400/20 bg-amber-400/5 text-amber-300 text-amber-200/80'. Should use ds-token warn surface variables.
Dispatch-disabled warning banner repeats the same hardcoded amber palette classes. Duplicate of line 200 pattern.

Icon.refresh inside Refresh button has aria-hidden="true" but the button has no aria-label. The visible text 'Refresh' is sufficient for sighted users, but if Icon is the only content in a narrow breakpoint collapse, no accessible name would survive. Low risk given visible text label.
Icon.send inside Dispatch button has aria-hidden="true"; visible text 'Dispatch'/'Dispatching…' provides the accessible name — no issue in practice. Noted for completeness.
Select and inputs use 'bg-black/40' directly instead of a ds-token surface variable (e.g. bg-overlay-deep or bg-surface-input).
